title: SET OF 6 ENGLISH OAK HIGH BACK...
reason: Complete matched set of six Edwardian carved-back dining chairs in good order; sets are worth more than singles and the timber and origin may be better than the title suggests.
findings: Four photos: the group of six, a close view of two chairs, the carved roundel and a seat. Set of six matching Edwardian style dining chairs: high backs with a shaped top rail, a carved roundel with a stylised Art Nouveau scroll on a punched (stippled) ground, three slender slats below, drop-in seats in later pale green damask, cabriole front legs, plain rear legs and side and back stretchers. The set looks complete and matched. The timber is honey-brown with a fine close grain; I could not see the ray fleck expected of oak, so 'English oak' cannot be confirmed from the photos (could be oak or another hardwood such as ash or an Australian timber). No maker's label, stamp or number seen; seat undersides and rails are not photographed.
condition: Good, clean looking polish with light wear; seat fabric is tidy with a few small spots; no broken legs, splats or repairs visible in the photos; stability and seat frame joints not shown.
rescore_note: Complete matched set of six Edwardian style carved-back chairs in good clean order; oak not confirmed from the photos and no maker mark, and the brown furniture market is soft, so a set value at the top of the $80-200 band. Estimate only, no live comps.
